description: This C# source file contains unit tests for database-backed asset validation and integrity, specifically testing uniqueness constraints, reporting attribute mapping, and hierarchy integrity in a backend system. The tests use Xunit and are focused on ensuring data consistency and validation enforcement through API calls against a persistent database.

classes.name: DbBackedUniquenessAndHierarchyIntegrityTests
classes.description: Contains database-backed tests for asset uniqueness, attribute mapping, and hierarchy integrity, ensuring validation logic correctly rejects invalid operations such as duplicates, self-parenting, and cyclical parent relationships.

methods.name: Create_asset_with_duplicate_permit_eu_id_returns_409
methods.description: Tests that creating an asset with a permit Eu ID that already exists returns HTTP 409 Conflict.

methods.name: Update_asset_to_duplicate_permit_eu_id_returns_409
methods.description: Tests that updating an asset to have a duplicate permit Eu ID returns HTTP 409 Conflict.

methods.name: Reporting_attribute_mapping_duplicate_combination_for_same_asset_returns_400
methods.description: Tests that attempting to create duplicate reporting attribute mappings for the same asset results in HTTP 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: Hierarchy_integrity_rejects_self_parent_and_cycles_400
methods.description: Tests that self-parenting and cyclical parent relations in assets are rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request.
